question: A can lay railway track between two given stations in 16 days and B can do the same job in 11 days. With the help of C, they did the job in 3 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM of 16, 11, and 3 = 528 units.

Efficiency of A = 528 ÷ 16 = 33 units/day.

Efficiency of B = 528 ÷ 11 = 48 units/day.

Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 528 ÷ 3 = 176 units/day.

Efficiency of C = 176 − (33 + 48) = 95 units/day.

Time taken by C = 528 ÷ 95 = 5⁵³/₉₅ days.

**∴ The correct answer is 5⁵³/₉₅ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 16 days

Time taken by B = 11 days

Time taken by A, B, and C together = 3 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = LCM of given days

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of A + B = 33 + 48 = 81

⇒ Efficiency of C = Efficiency of (A + B + C) − Efficiency of (A + B)

⇒ Efficiency of C = 176 − 81 = 95

⇒ Time taken by C alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of C

⇒ Time taken by C = 528 ÷ 95

⇒ Time taken by C = 5⁵³/₉₅ days

**∴ The correct answer is 5⁵³/₉₅ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed in proportion to the actual work done by each person, which directly depends on their efficiency if they work for an equal number of days.

Pipes and Cisterns

This concept is completely identical to Time & Work, but an emptying pipe acts as a person doing negative work, resulting in negative efficiency.

Alternate Day Work

When individuals work on alternate days, combine their individual efficiencies over the 2-day cycle to form a standard recurring block of work.
